data.one_liner: Animation utilities for markers and controls of the flutter_map package.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated controllers and marker layers for flutter_map, allowing smooth zoom, rotation, and center transitions as well as animated markers.
use_when: You are using flutter_map and need smooth animated transitions for map controllers and markers.
You want to animate map movements like rotation, zooming, and centering on points.
avoid_when: You are using Google Maps instead of flutter_map.
You do not need any animations or custom animated markers on your maps.
strengths: Provides AnimatedMarkerLayer for animating individual markers easily.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the flutter_map ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: requires flutter_map and latlong2 dependencies as part of your flutter_map setup
